stock.description: Longhui International Holdings Limited operates primarily as an investment holding company, with its core business revolving around hotpot restaurants located across the People's Republic of China. The firm manages and owns a network of 24 eateries, branded as Faigo and Xiao Faigo Hotpot. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong.
